prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a playful meme-style illustration of a cat reimagining a chubby, bright-yellow baby dragon mascot: make it unmistakably feline, with pointed ears, whiskers, a little rounded muzzle, and a curled tail, while keeping a soft, pudgy body and tiny stubby paws. Show it laughing uncontrollably, head tipped back, eyes squeezed into joyful crescents, mouth stretched wide open with a pink tongue and tiny teeth visible, cheeks lifted, and body wobbling with laughter. Use a simple clean cartoon style, bold smooth outlines, warm colors, and an uncluttered plain background. Center the whole character in frame; make the expression exaggerated and instantly readable. No words, captions, logos, or extra characters.
